headline: Supreme Court Librarian Refuses to Reorganize 'Sensitive Inquiry' Filing Cabinet, Citing Vastu Shastra Concerns
body:
The chief librarian of the Supreme Court has officially declined to move or reconstitute the physical paper files of a high-profile inquiry panel, stating that the current shelf arrangement aligns perfectly with the building's Vastu Shastra energy flow.

"To move these files would be to disrupt the structural integrity of the judicial vibrations in this wing," said the head librarian, who has spent the last three days physically blocking the cabinet with a stack of old Law Commission reports. "We have already had enough instability in the records department since we switched to using gold-plated staples; I refuse to risk the bad karma of rearranging an active probe for the sake of mere administrative accessibility."

Legal experts note that while the court refused to reconstitute the actual panel investigating recent violence, the librarian’s stance has effectively created a 'stalemate of stationery.' The files remain locked behind a hand-drawn sign reading 'Do Not Disturb - Cosmic Alignment in Progress,' leaving lawyers to file their motions via post-it notes attached to the exterior of the mahogany cabinetry.
caption: Nothing moves, not even the paperwork. 📂✨ #SupremeCourt #Vastu #Bureaucracy #Law #IndiaNews (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a building's energy flow over a court mandate?

It avoids the repetitive 'lunch menu' or 'stationery' tropes found in the other candidates, offering a fresher and more rhythmically distinct comedic beat.
